sentences.text: For Petitioner : Mr.R.Senthil Murugan (Party-  For R-1 to R-3 : Mr.P.Thilak Kumar  Government Pleader  For R-4 : Mr.T.Senthil Kumar  Additional Public Prosecuto  ORDER (Order of the Court was made by S.M.SUBRAMANIAM, J.)
In the context of the relief sought for in the present Writ Petition, admittedly, ban is in force for sale of gutkha in the State of Tamil Nadu.
The petitioner in person states that inspite of ban, the prohibited gutkhas and other items are made available openly in the market.
The police authorities are expected to be vigilant and in the event of any information, take appropriate action without causing any delay.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

2. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the fourth respondent would submit that on information, the complaint has been given to the Food Safety Officer and FIR has been communicated.
3. However, this Court is of the considered view that actions are inadequate and it has to be accelerated by the police authorities in coordination with the Food Safety Officers holding powers.
4. As far as the challenge made in the Writ Petition is concerned, the Government is periodically extending the ban.
That being so, no further interference is required.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands dismissed.
There shall be no order as to costs.

Consequently,
connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
